meta.name: prisma-client-api
meta.description: Prisma Client API reference covering model queries, filters, operators, and client methods. Use when writing database queries, using CRUD operations, filtering data, or configuring Prisma Client. Triggers on "prisma query", "findMany", "create", "update", "delete", "$transaction".

copy.tagline: 用 Prisma 查询和增删改数据库内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在用 Prisma 写数据库访问代码
copy.tagline_en: Query and manipulate database records with Prisma
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write database access code with Prisma

howto.what: 装上后，当你让 Claude 处理 Prisma 数据库相关任务时，它会依据 Prisma Client API 参考文档来编写或解释代码，涵盖模型查询（如 findMany、create）、过滤排序、关联关系、事务、原生 SQL 和客户端配置等，并提供具体示例。
howto.when: 当你说出“prisma query”、“findMany”、“create”等关键词，或要求编写数据库查询、执行增删改查（CRUD）、过滤数据、配置 Prisma Client 时触发。

say.text: 用 Prisma 写一个查询，找出所有管理员用户，按创建时间倒序。
say.note: Claude 会参考文档给出 findMany 示例。

say.text: 帮我写一个事务，同时创建用户和文章。
say.note: Claude 会给出 $transaction 的用法。

say.text: 这个查询怎么加用户名包含“alice”的过滤条件？

howto.what_en: When this skill is active, Claude uses the Prisma Client API reference to write or explain code for model queries (e.g., findMany, create), filtering/sorting, relations, transactions, raw SQL, and client configuration, providing concrete examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "prisma query", "findMany", "create" (etc.), or when you ask to write database queries, perform CRUD operations, filter data, or configure Prisma Client.

say_en.text: Write a Prisma query to find all admin users, ordered by creation time descending.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a findMany example.

say_en.text: Help me write a transaction that creates a user and a post together.
How do I add a filter like username contains 'alice' to this query?
say_en.note: Claude will explain where and contains.
